description: A ref that only tracks `.value` assignment. Its value is stored raw, without nested proxies.
Forces effects that depend on a shallow ref to run after you mutated its inner value.
Reactive object that tracks only root-level properties.
Marks an object so Vue never wraps it in a Proxy, even inside reactive state.
Returns the original object behind a reactive or readonly proxy. Useful for cloning and passing data to non-Vue APIs.
